decisions.reason: Core transactional email service aligned with strategic enterprise messaging direction despite reduced website visibility.
Document capture supports digital document workflow services and remains strategically relevant.
Legacy fax conversion service with low prominence and limited strategic fit for cloud-first multichannel direction.
Email sandbox threat protection is likely integrated into core email offering and not a standalone growth driver.
Multi-engine virus scanning is a commoditized security feature that can be absorbed into existing email security.
